resources.string: Sends torrents to your AllDebrid account for streaming and downloads. Requires Premium. Turn off to use local TorrServer. Cloud errors never switch to local torrenting automatically.
API key stored securely on this device
Add an API key to enable AllDebrid
Create an API key at alldebrid.com/apikeys. It is encrypted on this device and excluded from backups. Transfers remain in your AllDebrid account when playback stops.
Add or replace your AllDebrid API key in Player settings.
AllDebrid requires an active Premium account. Check your account status.
AllDebrid blocked this connection. Check your account and VPN settings.
AllDebrid is busy or a limit was reached. Wait before retrying.
AllDebrid is still preparing this torrent. Retry later; the cloud transfer continues.
The selected torrent file is unavailable or is not a supported video.
The API key could not be read or saved securely. Remove it and enter it again.
AllDebrid could not process this torrent. Check the transfer in your AllDebrid account.
Could not connect to AllDebrid or read its response. Please retry later.
